response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_rate AS difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC, a.AlbumId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The group with a NULL AlbumId is included when averaging rates across album groups.

alternatives.interpretation: The NULL AlbumId group appears in the results but is excluded from the average across albums.
